recommendation: Textile leads for the expressive motion-versus-living-stability contrast. Print is stronger for immediately recognisable record imagery. I recommend a textile-led identity with compatible, restrained print treatments for explanations, rather than mixing every motif in every image.
caveats: Independent pixel review cleared all eight applications after replacing the static hammock, repair-patch hero and scenes with unrelated décor. The Ateles sails still read partly as a kinetic tabletop sculpture; Neotoma cloth can read as a textile sample. Printed curvature suggests activity but does not prove movement. These remaining readings are subjective, not product evidence. The actual labels—not the material metaphors—explain the operational relationships.
